moon3d.wWelcome
Commander, welcome to the Moon's south pole! Let's walk together.
moon3d.wMorning
Good morning, Commander! A new day begins.
moon3d.wAlertMorning
It is dangerous outside today. Do not go far!
moon3d.wStormMorning
Space weather is lively today. Keep your eyes open!
moon3d.wIce
We found ice! Great for water and air.
moon3d.wBuilt
The tower is ready! It makes energy from tomorrow.
moon3d.wBuiltBattery
The battery is ready! We can store more energy.
moon3d.wBuiltGreenhouse
The greenhouse is ready! Plants make air.
moon3d.wBuildPrompt
Tap a golden spot. More sun means more energy!
moon3d.wShieldBuilt
The shield is ready! It cuts radiation.
moon3d.wGreenOn
Greenhouse lights are on!
moon3d.wStorm
Storm! Run back to base now!
moon3d.wSafe
Well done! We made it back in time.
moon3d.wSafeInside
The storm came, but we are safe inside the base.
moon3d.wLate
We were a bit late, but we made it.
moon3d.wLowEnergy
Energy is getting low. Shall we go home?
moon3d.wNoEnergy
Out of energy. Let's go home.
moon3d.needEnergy
Not enough energy.
moon3d.poi.sun
The Sun shines here about 75 percent of the time. A great spot for solar panels!
The Sun shines here about seventy five percent of the time. A great spot for solar panels!
moon3d.poi.rim
Shackleton crater at the Moon's south pole is about 21 kilometres wide and over 4 kilometres deep.
Shackleton crater at the Moon's south pole is about twenty one kilometres wide and over four kilometres deep.
moon3d.poi.earth
From here Earth is above the horizon almost all the time. Radio goes straight home.
moon3d.poi.ice-1
Sunlight never reaches this crater floor, 50 metres lower than the ground around it. Ice could hide here.
Sunlight never reaches this crater floor, fifty metres lower than the ground around it. Ice could hide here.
moon3d.poi.ice-2
This permanent shadow is as big as about 73 football pitches. The Sun never shines there.
This permanent shadow is as big as about seventy three football pitches. The Sun never shines there.
moon3d.poi.ice-3
Sunlight never reaches here, yet the Sun shines most of the time only 0.6 kilometres away.
Sunlight never reaches here, yet the Sun shines most of the time only zero point six kilometres away.
moon3d.poi.wall
The ground tilts about 22 degrees here, a steep crater wall. Walk carefully!
The ground tilts about twenty two degrees here, a steep crater wall. Walk carefully!
moon3d.poi.low
This is the lowest spot you can walk to, 980 metres below the landing site.
This is the lowest spot you can walk to, nine hundred and eighty metres below the landing site.
moon3d.poi.flat
The ground here is almost flat, tilting only 3 degrees. Flat places are best for landing and building.
The ground here is almost flat, tilting only three degrees. Flat places are best for landing and building.
